_comment: KADA A GYARA BAYAN SAKO - Tsare-tsaren da za a koma ga su kawai. Asalin tushen: Tarin 'strategies' na PocketBase

strategies.title: Dan Takara Daya
strategies.description: Lokacin da wani sel zai iya daukar lamba daya kawai saboda sauran lambobin sun riga sun kasance a cikin layi, ginshiƙi, ko akwatin 3x3.
examples: Ka yi tunanin layi wanda lambobi 1-8 suka riga sun kasance - sel ɗin da babu komai dole ne ya zama 9

strategies.title: Matsayi Daya
strategies.description: Lokacin da lamba za ta iya zuwa wani sel ɗaya kawai a cikin layi, ginshiƙi, ko akwatin saboda sauran wuraren sun riga sun cika.
examples: Idan akwatin 3x3 yana da lambobi 1-8 sai dai 9, kuma sel ɗaya kawai babu komai, wannan sel ɗin dole ne ya zama 9

strategies.title: Duban Layi/Ginshiƙi
strategies.description: Cire 'yan takara ta hanyar duba waɗanne lambobi suka riga sun kasance a cikin layi da ginshiƙi.
examples: Idan layin sel ɗin yana da 1,2,3 kuma ginshiƙi yana da 4,5, lambobin da za su iya zama sune 6-9

strategies.title: Rage Layin Akwatin
strategies.description: Lokacin da duk wuraren da lamba za ta iya kasancewa a akwatin suna cikin layi ko ginshiƙi guda, cire wannan lambar daga sauran layin/ginshiƙin a wajen akwatin.
examples: Idan a cikin akwatin, lamba 5 tana iya zuwa ne kawai a tsakiyar layi, cire 5 daga wannan layin a sauran akwatuna

strategies.title: Matsakaicin Kwanci
strategies.description: Lokacin da sel biyu a cikin rukuni suna da 'yan takara biyu iri ɗaya, waɗannan lambobin za a iya cire su daga sauran sel ɗin a cikin rukuni.
examples: Idan sel biyu a ginshiƙi na iya zama 2 ko 3 kawai, cire 2 da 3 daga sauran sel ɗin a wannan ginshiƙi

strategies.title: Ma'aurata Mai Nunawa
strategies.description: Lokacin da wurare biyu masu yiwuwar lamba a cikin akwatin suka daidaita a cikin layi ko ginshiƙi, cire wannan lambar daga sauran layi/ginshiƙin.
examples: Idan a cikin akwatin, 7 zai iya zuwa ne kawai a sel biyu a cikin ginshiƙi guda, cire 7 daga wannan ginshiƙin a sauran akwatuna

strategies.title: Sel ɗin Ƙarshe Mai Wanzuwa
strategies.description: Lokacin da duk lambobi amma ɗaya suka riga sun kasance a cikin layi, ginshiƙi, ko akwatin, lambar da ta rage dole ne ta shiga sel ɗin da babu komai.
examples: Idan layi yana da lambobi 1-8 tare da sel ɗaya babu komai, wannan sel ɗin dole ne ya zama 9

strategies.title: Bayyanar 'Yan Takara
strategies.description: Tsari ne na cire 'yan takara marasa yiwuwa ta hanyar nuna lambobin da za su iya zama a cikin sel ɗin da babu komai.
examples: Alama duk lambobin da za su iya zama don sel ɗin bisa ga layi, ginshiƙi, da akwatin
Idan lamba guda ɗaya ce kawai ba a nuna ba, dole ne ita ce mafita

strategies.title: Tsallaken Layuka
strategies.description: Duba akwatin ɗaya bayan ɗaya tare da bincika iyakokin layi da ginshiƙi.
examples: Mai da hankali kan akwatin ɗaya lokaci guda, duba lambobin da ba su bayyana ba
Domin kowace lamba da ba a samu ba, duba layi/ginshiƙi don gano wuraren da za ta iya kasancewa

strategies.title: Layin 'Yan Takara
strategies.description: Lokacin da duk wuraren da lamba za ta iya kasancewa a cikin block suke cikin layi ɗaya ko ginshiƙi ɗaya, cire wannan lamba daga sauran layin/ginshiƙin a wasu blocks.
examples: Idan a cikin akwatin 3x3, 5 zai iya kasancewa ne kawai a saman layi, cire 5 daga sauran wannan layin a wasu akwatuna

strategies.title: Ma'auratan Bayyane
strategies.description: Lokacin da sel biyu a cikin rukuni ke dauke da lambobi biyu iri ɗaya, cire waɗannan lambobin daga sauran sel ɗin cikin rukunin.
examples: Idan sel biyu a layi suna iya zama 3 ko 7 kawai, cire 3 da 7 daga sauran sel ɗin a cikin wannan layi

strategies.title: Kwamitin Bayyananne Uku
strategies.description: Lokacin da sel uku a cikin rukuni ke dauke da lambobi uku iri ɗaya, cire waɗannan lambobin daga sauran sel ɗin cikin rukunin.
examples: Idan sel uku a cikin ginshiƙi suna iya zama 4, 5, ko 6 a wasu tsaruka, cire waɗannan lambobin daga sauran sel ɗin a cikin ginshiƙi

strategies.title: Kwamitin Boye Uku
strategies.description: Lokacin da lambobi uku suka bayyana ne kawai a cikin sel uku a rukuni, cire sauran 'yan takara daga cikin waɗannan sel ɗin.
examples: Idan lambobi 2, 4, da 6 sun bayyana ne kawai a cikin sel uku a akwatin, dole ne waɗannan sel su ƙunshi waɗannan lambobin

strategies.title: X-Wing (Asali)
strategies.description: Lokacin da lamba ta bayyana ne a layuka biyu da ginshiƙi biyu da suke samar da murabba'i, cire wannan lambar daga sauran layuka da ginshiƙi waɗanda ba cikin murabba'in ba.
examples: Idan 7 ta bayyana ne kawai a layuka 2 da 5 a ginshiƙi 3 da 7, cire sauran 7 a waɗannan ginshiƙi

strategies.title: Launuka Masu Sauƙi
strategies.description: Amfani da launuka biyu don bin diddigin yiwuwar lambobi don gano rashin daidaito ko tabbacin wurare.
examples: Idan duk 5 da za su iya yiwuwa suna haɗe a wani sarkakiya inda launuka ke canzawa, za a iya cire yiwuwar da za su tilasta samun 5 biyu a rukuni ɗaya

strategies.title: Y-Wing
strategies.description: Wani dabarar amfani da sel uku da aka haɗa kamar juyin gefe da manyan hannu biyu don cire 'yan takara.
examples: Idan sel A (3,5) ya haɗu da B (3,7) da C (5,7), kowanne sel da ke ganin B da C ba zai iya zama 7 ba

strategies.title: Gine-Ginen Tsawo
strategies.description: Haɗin ƙarfi biyu don ɗan takara wanda ke da layi ko ginshiƙi ɗaya, yana ba da damar cirewa.
examples: Idan ɗan takara 5 ya bayyana sau biyu a cikin ginshiƙi kuma yana ƙirƙirar siffar 'skyscraper' tare da wani ginshiƙi
Za a iya cire 5 daga sel ɗin da ke gani ga 'towers' na skyscraper biyu

strategies.title: Kite Mai Igiya Biyu
strategies.description: Lamba wacce ke haɗa layi da ginshiƙi ta hanyar akwatin da aka raba, yana ƙirƙirar damar cirewa.
examples: Lokacin da ɗan takara a layi ya haɗu da ɗan takara a ginshiƙi ta hanyar akwatin da aka raba
Cire ɗan takara daga sel ɗin haɗin gwiwa

strategies.title: Ma'auratan Boye
strategies.description: Lokacin da lambobi biyu suka bayyana ne kawai a cikin sel biyu na rukuni guda, cire sauran 'yan takara daga cikin waɗannan sel ɗin.
examples: Idan a cikin ginshiƙi, lambobi 4 da 5 suna bayyana ne kawai a cikin sel biyu tare, dole ne waɗannan sel su ƙunshi 4 da 5

strategies.title: X-Wing
strategies.description: Lokacin da lamba ta bayyana ne a layuka biyu da ginshiƙi biyu da suke samar da murabba'i, cire wannan lambar daga sauran layuka da ginshiƙi waɗanda ba cikin murabba'in ba.
examples: Idan 7 ta bayyana ne kawai a layuka 2 da 5 a ginshiƙi 3 da 7, cire sauran 7 a waɗannan ginshiƙi

strategies.title: Kifi Mai Taro
strategies.description: Wani sigar X-Wing mai amfani da layuka uku da ginshiƙi uku maimakon biyu.
examples: Idan lamba 3 ta bayyana a layuka uku da ginshiƙi uku a wani tsari na musamman, za a iya cire sauran 3 a cikin waɗannan ginshiƙi

strategies.title: XYZ-Wing
strategies.description: Tsawaita Y-Wing ta amfani da sel uku inda pivot ɗin ke dauke da 'yan takara uku.
examples: Idan sel A (4,5,6) ya haɗu da B (4,7) da C (5,7), kowanne sel da ke ganin duka B da C ba zai iya zama 7 ba

strategies.title: W-Wing
strategies.description: Dabarar amfani da sel biyu masu ɗauke da 'yan takara biyu iri ɗaya da aka haɗa ta hanyar haɗin ƙarfi.
examples: Idan sel biyu (1,9) suna haɗe ta hanyar sarkar 1s, ɗaya daga cikinsu dole ne ya zama 9

strategies.title: Jellyfish
strategies.description: Tsari mai ci gaba mai kama da Kifi Mai Taro amma yana amfani da layuka hudu da ginshiƙi hudu.
examples: Lokacin da lamba ta bayyana a layuka hudu da ginshiƙi hudu a cikin tsari na musamman, yana bada damar cirewa

strategies.title: Murabba'in Musamman
strategies.description: Tsari wanda ke hana mafita da yawa ta hanyar tilasta wasu wurare.
examples: Idan sel hudu suka kafa murabba'i tare da 'yan takara biyu iri ɗaya, dole ne a sami ƙarin ƙa'idodi don hana mafita da yawa

strategies.title: Sarkar XY
strategies.description: Sarkar sel ɗin da aka haɗa inda kowace haɗin ke raba ɗan takara tare da na gaba, yana bada damar cirewa a ƙarshen sarkar.
examples: 4-6 → 6-9 → 9-2 → 2-7 sarkar na nufin ɗaya daga ƙarshen dole ne ya zama 4 ko 7
Cire 'yan takara waɗanda ke gani ga ƙarshen biyu na sarkar

strategies.title: ALS-XZ
strategies.description: Kungiyoyi biyu na 'Almost Locked Sets' da ke raba 'yan takara masu takaita, suna bada damar cirewa mai ci gaba.
examples: Lokacin da kungiyoyi biyu na sel suka raba ɗan takara ɗaya kawai
Za a iya cire wannan ɗan takara daga sel ɗin da ake gani

strategies.title: Furen Mutuwa
strategies.description: Tsari mai ci gaba wanda ke amfani da sel ɗin tsakiya da aka haɗa da kungiyoyi da dama na ALS.
examples: Sel ɗin tsakiya da ke haɗe da kungiyoyi uku na ALS
Ana yin cirewa bisa ƙa'idodin da aka raba

strategies.title: Network Links
strategies.description: Using a large network of links to track possibilities and reveal contradictions.
examples: If network forces candidate to exist twice in same unit, eliminate candidate

strategies.title: Nodding Cycle
strategies.description: A cycle of links where candidate presence in one spot leads to contradiction, allowing elimination.
examples: If placing candidate causes return to invalid state, eliminate that candidate

strategies.title: Balancing Chain
strategies.description: Using chain of links to balance candidate placement and eliminate incorrect possibilities.
examples: All chains leading to specific candidate show it must be correct

strategies.title: Digit Presence Check
strategies.description: Examining digit presence across multiple regions to determine forced placements or eliminations.
examples: If digit appears only twice across all regions, its placement may be determined

strategies.title: Candidate Chain
strategies.description: Analyzing chains involving different candidates to determine contradictions or forced placements.
examples: Chain connecting different candidates can eliminate choices in certain cells

strategies.title: Collective Strong Links
strategies.description: Analyzing strong links derived from multiple candidates together.
examples: Using strong links derived from more than one candidate to find solution

strategies.title: Sarkar Tilasta Lamba
strategies.description: Gwada wuraren da 'yan takara za su iya kasancewa don gano rashin daidaito ko tabbatarwa a cikin sel da dama.
examples: Yi zaton ɗan takara gaskiya ne ka bi sakamakon hakan
Idan hakan ya kai ga rashin daidaito, ɗan takarar dole ne ya zama ƙarya

strategies.title: Launuka da yawa
strategies.description: Tsawaita launuka da yawa don bin diddigin hulɗar 'yan takara masu rikitarwa.
examples: Amfani da launuka 4 ko fiye don bibiyar dogaro da 'yan takara
Gano cirewa inda launuka ke yin karo

strategies.title: Saurin Taro na Tsari
strategies.description: Haɗa tsarukan 'yan takara don gano wuraren da ba za a iya kauce wa cirewa ba.
examples: Taswirar duk wuraren da ɗan takara zai iya kasancewa
Gano sel ɗin da dole ne a cire ɗan takara daga cikinsu
